links.outcome: Demographic representation of surgeons in AI-generated images versus real-world demographics
links.effect: Statistical underrepresentation of female and Black microsurgeons; overrepresentation of female (64.0%) and Black (16.0%) US plastic surgeons; exclusively Asian surgeons in Japan; equipment inaccurately depicted (loupes 46.0%, surgical microscope 4.0%).
links.quote: The AI model predominantly generated images of male and female surgeons with a statistical underrepresentation of female and Black microsurgeons.

screen.reason: Evaluates bias and representation (demographics and equipment accuracy) in images of surgeons generated by DALL-E 3 (Copilot Creative Mode).
